events.description:
Hi everyone!

As you know, this month 45B is doing a sprint of Web3 Workshops, engaging with one cohort in Portuguese and two in English as we close this project. 

Besides this, we have a multilingual resources initiative in which we aim to support Web3 learners that can't come to our calls and prefer to learn on their own time. We're starting with English, Portuguese, French and Spanish, and aim to add as many languages as we have native speakers to help review translations.

It's in this context that we'll be hosting open community calls to bring together Learners and Educators from all corners of the Cardano world. 

Async learners will still have an opportunity to clarify questions in "no agenda" sessions. And Educators will get to network, help learners, and each other.

We hope you find this interesting, and that you can come by for a few of these sessions we'll be organizing at least until the 30th. Please let us know if you have any feedback at all, and please have a look at https://45b.io/web3 for a bit more context.

https://meet.google.com/pqw-txeu-fkp
events.descriptionText:
Hi everyone!

As you know, this month 45B is doing a sprint of Web3 Workshops, engaging with one cohort in Portuguese and two in English as we close this project. 

Besides this, we have a multilingual resources initiative in which we aim to support Web3 learners that can't come to our calls and prefer to learn on their own time. We're starting with English, Portuguese, French and Spanish, and aim to add as many languages as we have native speakers to help review translations.

It's in this context that we'll be hosting open community calls to bring together Learners and Educators from all corners of the Cardano world. 

Async learners will still have an opportunity to clarify questions in "no agenda" sessions. And Educators will get to network, help learners, and each other.

We hope you find this interesting, and that you can come by for a few of these sessions we'll be organizing at least until the 30th. Please let us know if you have any feedback at all, and please have a look at https://45b.io/web3 for a bit more context.

https://meet.google.com/pqw-txeu-fkp
